summary: The delegation (The person, 2026-10-27: delegating the request and asking for delivery without involving them) covers this question. No reading is recommended, so the answer takes the one a test can check and that does not clash with r51.
answer: Reading 2: only a sent turn (with any answers sent with it) makes the request await the upstream, so an answer sent alone leaves `work show` printing the asker's turn under r51; and 'awaiting the upstream' is only the description printed of who acts next, not a new status named awaiting-upstream. (Under the delegation of The person, 2026-10-27: "I'm delegating this to you. Please get the new version delivered without involving me.")
